name: How long does it take to replace a single warped window frame?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to replace a single warped window frame?

acceptedAnswer.text: Replacing a single warped window frame typically takes a professional crew a few hours, from start to finish. This duration can vary based on several factors, including the type and size of the window, the condition of the surrounding wall, and whether any structural adjustments are needed for the new frame. While the physical installation is often quick, the overall project timeline also includes initial consultation, measurement, custom ordering of the new window, and scheduling.
acceptedAnswer.description: Replacing one warped window frame usually takes a few hours, depending on window type, size, and wall condition. This excludes consultation and ordering time.
